events.title: In That Case... is participating in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone!In That Case... is officially taking part in Steam Next Fest, October 19–26!If you haven't tried the game yet, now's a great time to jump into the free demo.You'll get to experience a slice of story mode, learn the ropes of opening cases, managing your money and debt, and surviving the growing threat of the descending ceiling spikes. events.summary: Hello! events.title: Dev Update/Newsletter September
events.summary: I haven't done these in a while. The game is coming together well, as of a week or so the main STORY MODE is complete and functions as more of a context and tutorial for ENDLESS MODE which is now under full focus development. With story mode behind, endless mode unlocks the ability to well, play endlessly.
